academic_units_fields_valid.name: academic_units_fields_valid
academic_units_fields_valid.value: btrim("academic_units"."kind") <> '' AND btrim("academic_units"."name") <> '' AND btrim("academic_units"."code") <> '' AND "academic_units"."code" = upper(btrim("academic_units"."code"))

institution_invitations_acceptance_compl.name: institution_invitations_acceptance_complete
institution_invitations_acceptance_compl.value: ("institution_invitations"."accepted_at" IS NULL AND "institution_invitations"."accepted_user_id" IS NULL AND "institution_invitations"."accepted_membership_id" IS NULL) OR ("institution_invitations"."accepted_at" IS NOT NULL AND "institution_invitations"."accepted_user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "institution_invitations"."accepted_membership_id" IS NOT NULL)

institution_invitations_revocation_compl.name: institution_invitations_revocation_complete
institution_invitations_revocation_compl.value: ("institution_invitations"."revoked_at" IS NULL AND "institution_invitations"."revocation_reason" IS NULL) OR ("institution_invitations"."revoked_at" IS NOT NULL AND "institution_invitations"."revocation_reason" IN ('administrator', 'replaced'))

account_recovery_requests_token_user_com.name: account_recovery_requests_token_user_complete
account_recovery_requests_token_user_com.value: "account_recovery_requests"."token_hash" IS NULL OR "account_recovery_requests"."user_id" IS NOT NULL

account_recovery_requests_delivery_state.name: account_recovery_requests_delivery_state_valid
account_recovery_requests_delivery_state.value: ("account_recovery_requests"."status" = 'pending' AND "account_recovery_requests"."token_hash" IS NULL AND "account_recovery_requests"."delivered_at" IS NULL AND "account_recovery_requests"."consumed_at" IS NULL) OR ("account_recovery_requests"."status" IN ('delivering', 'failed') AND "account_recovery_requests"."token_hash" IS NOT NULL AND "account_recovery_requests"."delivered_at" IS NULL AND "account_recovery_requests"."consumed_at" IS NULL) OR ("account_recovery_requests"."status" = 'delivered' AND "account_recovery_requests"."token_hash" IS NOT NULL AND "account_recovery_requests"."delivered_at" IS NOT NULL AND "account_recovery_requests"."consumed_at" IS NULL) OR ("account_recovery_requests"."status" = 'consumed' AND "account_recovery_requests"."token_hash" IS NOT NULL AND "account_recovery_requests"."delivered_at" IS NOT NULL AND "account_recovery_requests"."consumed_at" IS NOT NULL) OR ("account_recovery_requests"."status" IN ('discarded', 'expired', 'revoked') AND "account_recovery_requests"."consumed_at" IS NULL)

account_recovery_requests_revocation_com.name: account_recovery_requests_revocation_complete
account_recovery_requests_revocation_com.value: ("account_recovery_requests"."revoked_at" IS NULL AND "account_recovery_requests"."revocation_reason" IS NULL) OR ("account_recovery_requests"."revoked_at" IS NOT NULL AND "account_recovery_requests"."revocation_reason" IN ('replaced', 'reset'))

lecture_audio_captures_handoff_measureme.name: lecture_audio_captures_handoff_measurements_valid
lecture_audio_captures_handoff_measureme.value:
(
        "lecture_audio_captures"."hashing_duration_ms" IS NULL
        AND "lecture_audio_captures"."upload_duration_ms" IS NULL
        AND "lecture_audio_captures"."upload_retry_count" IS NULL
      ) OR (
        "lecture_audio_captures"."hashing_duration_ms" IS NOT NULL
        AND "lecture_audio_captures"."upload_duration_ms" IS NOT NULL
        AND "lecture_audio_captures"."upload_retry_count" IS NOT NULL
        AND "lecture_audio_captures"."hashing_duration_ms" >= 0
        AND "lecture_audio_captures"."upload_duration_ms" >= 0
        AND "lecture_audio_captures"."upload_retry_count" >= 0
      )

lecture_audio_derivatives_processing_sta.name: lecture_audio_derivatives_processing_state_valid
lecture_audio_derivatives_processing_sta.value: ("lecture_audio_derivatives"."status" = 'processing' AND "lecture_audio_derivatives"."processing_started_at" IS NOT NULL) OR ("lecture_audio_derivatives"."status" <> 'processing' AND "lecture_audio_derivatives"."processing_started_at" IS NULL)

lecture_audio_derivatives_ready_state_va.name: lecture_audio_derivatives_ready_state_valid
lecture_audio_derivatives_ready_state_va.value: ("lecture_audio_derivatives"."status" = 'ready' AND "lecture_audio_derivatives"."storage_provider" IS NOT NULL AND btrim("lecture_audio_derivatives"."storage_provider") <> '' AND "lecture_audio_derivatives"."storage_key" IS NOT NULL AND btrim("lecture_audio_derivatives"."storage_key") <> '' AND "lecture_audio_derivatives"."byte_size" IS NOT NULL AND "lecture_audio_derivatives"."byte_size" > 0 AND "lecture_audio_derivatives"."sha256" IS NOT NULL AND "lecture_audio_derivatives"."sha256" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' AND "lecture_audio_derivatives"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL) OR ("lecture_audio_derivatives"."status" <> 'ready' AND "lecture_audio_derivatives"."storage_provider" IS NULL AND "lecture_audio_derivatives"."storage_key" IS NULL AND "lecture_audio_derivatives"."byte_size" IS NULL AND "lecture_audio_derivatives"."sha256" IS NULL AND "lecture_audio_derivatives"."completed_at" IS NULL)

lecture_audio_uploads_completion_valid.name: lecture_audio_uploads_completion_valid
lecture_audio_uploads_completion_valid.value: ("lecture_audio_uploads"."status" = 'completed' AND "lecture_audio_uploads"."received_bytes" = "lecture_audio_uploads"."byte_size" AND "lecture_audio_uploads"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL) OR ("lecture_audio_uploads"."status" <> 'completed' AND "lecture_audio_uploads"."completed_at" IS NULL)

lecture_media_holds_release_complete.name: lecture_media_holds_release_complete
lecture_media_holds_release_complete.value:
(
        ("lecture_media_holds"."released_at" IS NULL AND "lecture_media_holds"."released_by_membership_id" IS NULL AND "lecture_media_holds"."release_reason" IS NULL)
        OR ("lecture_media_holds"."released_at" IS NOT NULL AND "lecture_media_holds"."released_at" >= "lecture_media_holds"."created_at" AND "lecture_media_holds"."released_by_membership_id" IS NOT NULL AND btrim("lecture_media_holds"."release_reason") = "lecture_media_holds"."release_reason" AND char_length("lecture_media_holds"."release_reason") BETWEEN 1 AND 500)
      )

media_object_intents_state_complete.name: media_object_intents_state_complete
media_object_intents_state_complete.value:
(
        ("media_object_intents"."status" = 'pending' AND "media_object_intents"."attached_at" IS NULL AND "media_object_intents"."deleted_at" IS NULL)
        OR ("media_object_intents"."status" = 'attached' AND "media_object_intents"."attached_at" IS NOT NULL AND "media_object_intents"."deleted_at" IS NULL)
        OR ("media_object_intents"."status" = 'deleting' AND "media_object_intents"."deleted_at" IS NULL)
        OR ("media_object_intents"."status" = 'deleted' AND "media_object_intents"."deleted_at" IS NOT NULL)
      )
